title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We're excited to announce the official launch of Spyglass, delivering powerful new capabilities to enhance your experience.

title: Enhanced File Management
summary: Experience unparalleled control over your content with our enhanced file management system, allowing you to easily upload, remove, and customize the display of images and documents directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: We've launched a brand new public roadmap, offering complete transparency into our past accomplishments, current projects, and exciting future plans.

title: Improved Checkboxes for Effortless Task Management
summary: We've upgraded our checkboxes with a modern design, making them bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable to streamline your task management experience.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've significantly upgraded the editor to make working with your team smoother and more intuitive, ensuring everyone stays perfectly in sync.

title: Enhanced Collaboration & Discoverability
summary: Now, effortlessly discover and interact with all relevant shared content, making collaboration with your friends and team more intuitive and powerful.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're making Noeko's codebase publicly available, empowering you with greater control, direct involvement, and full transparency in the future of the project.

title: Worldwide Language Accessibility
summary: Noeko is expanding its horizons to offer comprehensive support for international languages, ensuring a seamless experience for users around the world.

title: Personalized Styling: New Themes & Refinements
summary: Our platform is getting a stylish upgrade with beautifully refined existing themes and an exciting array of brand-new aesthetic choices.

title: Interactive Knowledge Map
summary: Explore your entire knowledge base with unprecedented clarity and control thanks to powerful new filtering options by tags, time, and shared connections.

title: Smart Search & Personalized Collections
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint the information you need with dynamic filters and advanced sorting options, and save your customized search results as personal collections for immediate access.

title: Flexible Views for Intuitive Note Organization
summary: Experience a more intuitive way to organize your thoughts with flexible new views that transform how you display and interact with linked content, mirroring your unique thought process.

title: Unlock Noeko: Self-Hosting and New Subscription Options
summary: Experience ultimate control and tailored features with Noeko's new self-hosting capabilities and flexible paid plans.

title: Smarter Greetings for Every Time of Day
summary: We're improving our app to ensure greetings like "Good morning" or "Good evening" always accurately reflect the current time of day for a more personalized experience.

title: Enhanced Tag View Actions
summary: Effortlessly organize your tagged items by enabling direct bulk actions, such as unapplying tags or deleting entries, right from the tag's overview.

title: Bring All Your Content Together
summary: Get ready to effortlessly bring all your diverse content, from YouTube videos and websites to text files, into one powerful platform for unified viewing and note-taking.
